fusions.name: Scupper Wash
fusions.desc: Pumps a jet through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy back 2.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Heave It Overboard
fusions.desc: Throws the poison back at the first enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 16 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each. For 4 seconds after, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Pump the Bilges
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies and restores 10 health. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Clean Bill of Health
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently 8% higher, and you carry 12% poison resistance.
